story.head: Four points for Matthew Tkachuk as the Panthers beat the Jets
paras: Carter Verhaeghe scored twice and Niko Mikkola once in just under three minutes early in the first to put the Panthers up 3-0. Adam Lowry got the Jets on the board shorthanded midway through the second, and Sam Reinhart made it 4-1 for the Cats on the power play 47 seconds later. Brady Tkachuk stretched the lead to 5-1 with just under eight minutes left. Matthew Tkachuk finished with four assists, and Brady Tkachuk had a goal and two assists.
Don’t let the score fool you: the chances were a lot closer than that. Akira Schmid made 24 saves for the Panthers, and Clay Stevenson allowed five goals on 24 shots.
The Panthers scored three power-play goals on five chances. The Panthers moved to 7-4-2 and climbed to fourth in the Atlantic, while the Jets fell to 4-5-3, seventh in the Central.
